stats.text: You can make an Opportunity Attack when a creature that you can see leaves your reach using its action, its {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, its {ref:glossary/reaction}, or one of its speeds. To make the Opportunity Attack, take a Reaction to make one melee attack with a weapon or an {ref:glossary/unarmed-strike} against the provoking creature. The attack occurs right before the creature leaves your reach. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("Combat").
